description: List projects accessible by the current user. For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

membership.description: Filter for projects where current user is a member

owned.description: Filter for projects owned by current user

per_page.description: Number of items per page (max: 100, default: 20)

search_namespaces.description: Needs to be true if search is full path

sort.description: Return projects sorted in ascending or descending order

summary.description: If true, return only high-signal fields (id, iid, title, state, web_url, …). Default false keeps the full GitLab JSON.

topic.description: Filter by topic (projects tagged with this topic)

with_issues_enabled.description: Filter projects with issues feature enabled

with_merge_requests_enabled.description: Filter projects with merge requests feature enabled

name: list_projects
